lead: A date or a moment as text in the language of the app, as a `<time>` element with the exact moment in its `dateTime`. It follows the `locale` of ConfigProvider, so a page needs no `Intl.DateTimeFormat` of its own. `formatDateText` gives the same text as a string (a CSV cell, a title). For "5 minutes ago" use [Relative Time](/relative-time).

styles.title: How much to say
styles.description: `dateStyle` and `timeStyle` take `short`, `medium`, `long` or `full`; `timeStyle` alone shows the time only.

empty.title: No value
empty.description: A missing or invalid value shows `fallback`, a dash by default, so a column of optional dates needs no `?:`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: DateText renders a plain `<time>` with no slot: style it with the text around it.
